title: Ex-Google PM Builds God's Eye to Monitor Iran in 4D
speaker: Bilawal Sidhu

discoveries.name: AI Agent Swarm for Real-Time OSINT Collection
discoveries.description: Sidhu deployed an AI agent swarm to autonomously capture open-source intelligence signals (satellite passes, ADS-B, AIS, GPS jamming) during Operation Epic Fury in real-time. Multi-source autonomous data collection and correlation by agents.

discoveries.name: The Intelligence Monopoly Is Over
discoveries.description: Commercial satellite constellations + public data feeds + browser-based visualization = solo builders can now produce intelligence products that previously required nation-state infrastructure. Mirrors the broader AI democratization thesis.

discoveries.name: Temporal Correlation Reveals Operational Intent
discoveries.description: The intelligence value is not in any single data source but in sequencing and correlating multiple feeds on a unified timeline. When open feeds are time-aligned, the sequence of actions reveals intent. Applicable to agent observability and devlog correlation.

discoveries.name: WorldView
discoveries.description: Browser-based geospatial command center fusing satellite orbits, ADS-B, AIS, GPS interference, CCTV, and night vision/FLIR onto a 3D globe. Built in 3 days by solo developer with 6 years Google Maps experience. Public launch planned April 2026.

deep_dive_candidates.title: I Built a Spy Satellite Simulator in a Browser (Substack)
